findings.title: Codex CLI resume fails after a successful first text turn
findings.details: Codex CLI 0.157.1 against packaged7608: first text passes, resume --last uses same thread but fails with missing cwd in trusted Codex environment context. Six SSE responses reflect client retries; tool step was not run. Scope correct preservation/derivation of real trusted environment on continuation; do not fabricate cwd or permissions.

findings.title: Current Claude Code session header is not recognized
findings.details: Claude2.1.283 sends x-claude-code-session-id and session metadata.user_id; gateway_request.request_context_from_headers and chatgpt_web_client_session.client_session_id resolve no session. OpenCode1.18.32 X-Session-Id resolves. Local endpoint intentionally returns400; this proves request-contract mismatch, not live model success.

findings.title: Successful promotion followed by failed startup does not restore previous-good
findings.details: Known-good runtime starts; verified replacement is promoted; replacement exits17 and startup fails. Previous-good remains, current is not restored, no runtime running. Probe cleanup passed. Test uses synthetic archives and no account.
